_comment: User stories of the journeys J1 to J4: what a reader acting in a role wants. Schema: cat-harness/schemas/user-story.ts.
name: smart-trust-demo

stories.want: Have my daughter's birth doses recognised at home
stories.soThat: they are not repeated and she stays on schedule

stories.want: Show every family member's records abroad from one phone with one passcode each
stories.soThat: a doctor abroad can treat us without paper or an app

stories.want: Print a signed record of each birth dose the family can carry anywhere
Read a foreign vaccination QR offline and register the child with it
stories.soThat: the clinic sees what was given before the family arrives

stories.want: Refer a child whose foreign record needs checking
stories.soThat: verification is done by someone who can

stories.want: Know whether a foreign certificate is genuine, and why not when it is not
See which doses are due once the foreign doses are imported
stories.soThat: I give only what is missing

stories.want: Read a visiting child's summary and vaccinations from a QR the parent shows
stories.soThat: without installing anything or calling another country
